facility_overview: HCC High School operates a fleet of dedicated school buses and vans managed with stringent child safety protocols covering all major residential corridors in Solapur.
safety_features: GPS tracking on all vehicles with real-time location alerts
Female bus attendants on all routes for pre-primary and primary children
Experienced drivers with mandatory police verification and annual health screening
Speed governors installed (max speed 40 km/h in city limits)
First-aid emergency kits and operational fire extinguishers in every vehicle
CCTV surveillance cameras inside all buses
registration_notes: Transport seats are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis at the time of admission form finalization.
